mobbin:aa5da6b8-f37f-485c-9aea-ffa69cc0e.summary: User opens Insights → Bookings, scopes account/team + Last 7 Days, scans KPI cards and Event Trends, then scrolls to popular-events / member leaderboards and an empty Recent ratings CTA.
steps: Insights Bookings — KPI grid + Event Trends (Your account)
Account search dropdown open on Bookings insights
Team: ASMobt scoped — Created/Cancelled spike on chart
Lower cards — Popular Events, duration chart, Most/Least Booked
Most Cancelled + Recent ratings empty → Workflows CTA
steal: Every KPI card shows value + colored arrow + “from last period” (steps 0–3) — comparable performance without a builder.
Multi-series Event Trends with day tooltip breaking Created/Completed/Rescheduled/Cancelled (step 3).
Member leaderboards for Most Booked / Least Booked / Most Cancelled (steps 4–5) — faculty utilisation ranking.
Recent ratings empty state with Workflows button to enable collection (step 5).
avoid: Eight always-visible KPI cards with many zeros and 0% deltas (steps 0–2) — noisy for sparse sim centers; prefer fewer utilisation-first metrics.
mobbin:aa5da6b8-f37f-485c-9aea-ffa69cc0e.fit: Maps to missing utilisation + calendar-generated room/faculty-hour KPIs and comparable performance; Download is light export, not dean digests-by-link.

mobbin:ff3d88ad-6b47-453f-9f8f-5f333707e.summary: User opens Insights → Routing, filters team/form, reads response→booking funnel cards and response table, then pivots Routed-to-per-period day/week/month and Failed bookings by field.
steps: Routing insights — empty funnel cards + response table + Routed to per period
Team + form filtered — Responses 4 / Without 3 / With 1 + Accepted row
Routed to per period — Per day/week/month toggle + user×week matrix
Failed Bookings By Field — role bar breakdown (Illustrator 3)
steal: Funnel KPI trio: Total Responses / Without Booking / With Booking (steps 0–1).
Routed to per period: day/week/month toggle + user×period matrix (step 2) — faculty-hour style load.
Failed Bookings By Field horizontal bars from form answers (step 3).
Segment/Save/Clear + Download on the report chrome (steps 0–1).
mobbin:ff3d88ad-6b47-453f-9f8f-5f333707e.fit: Strong model for utilisation by person over weekly/monthly buckets; aligns with auto dean digests’ period grain without a deep report builder.
